requirements_summary: Latency-sensitive consumer-facing chat (web + mobile) and high-rate reranking pipelines. Target p95 end-to-end <= 120ms for chat generate calls at typical prompt lengths (avg 80 tokens), throughput target 600-1,200 qps for reranking (batch-friendly). Cost sensitivity: reduce per-token cost via batching + prefix/KV caching + int8 quantization; willing to trade small quality delta for 30-50% cost savings. Must support SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS; data residency controls for EU customers. Preference for model variants: Llama2-13B (quantized) as primary, fallback to 7B distilled model for spike handling. Need predictable burst capacity and autoscaling with graceful fallback routing between hosted and dedicated pools.
